tokens.name: canopy
tokens.usage: Ground of Brady's own windows (Settings, the break screen) and of previews; never behind toasts, which sit on the user's wallpaper.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque stand-in for glass and glass-strong when Windows 'Transparency effects' is off or the window loses focus.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent panels inside Brady's own windows (settings cards, glass buttons). Blur behind it with blur-glass.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Every toast. Opaque enough that ink, ink-muted and the tone colors stay at 4.5:1 over any wallpaper, white or black.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px highlight border on glass and glass-strong surfaces; decorative, never the only boundary.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between settings rows and glass-button borders; decorative only.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Outline of an unchecked switch track and other control borders that carry state; 3:1 or more on canopy, glass and glass-strong.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on canopy, surface-solid, glass and glass-strong.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Toast body copy, captions, quiet buttons and unchecked switch thumbs, on the same grounds as ink.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The brand color and the Posture tone: primary button fill, checked switch, countdown ring, focus ring; as text on canopy, glass, glass-strong or moss-soft.

tokens.name: moss-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind moss text (the Posture chip) and the countdown ring's track.

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a moss or moss-hover fill, never plain white in dark.

tokens.name: fur
tokens.usage: Brady's coat as a UI color and the Stretch tone; as text on canopy, glass, glass-strong or fur-soft.

tokens.name: fur-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind fur text (the Stretch chip).

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: Sunrise coral, the Move tone (walk breaks); as text on canopy, glass, glass-strong or bloom-soft. Never an error color: Brady has no errors to shout.

tokens.name: bloom-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind bloom text (the Move chip).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The Eyes and Water tones; as text on canopy, glass, glass-strong or sky-soft. Eyes and Water share it, so their chips always carry the icon and the word.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind sky text (the Eyes and Water chips).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline, offset 2px, on every control. An alias of moss, so it holds 3:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: brady-coat
tokens.usage: Mascot only: Brady's head fur. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brady-coat-deep
tokens.usage: Mascot only: Brady's arms.

tokens.name: brady-face
tokens.usage: Mascot only: Brady's face and closed-eye lines.

tokens.name: brady-mask
tokens.usage: Mascot only: the eye bands, nose and mouth.

tokens.name: brady-claw
tokens.usage: Mascot only: the three claws hooked over the toast edge.

tokens.name: brady-leaf
tokens.usage: Mascot only: the leaf sprouting from Brady's head (sloths grow algae; Brady grows a leaf).

families.display: Fredoka, "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: Figtree, "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The break screen headline and Settings page title. One per window.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Toast titles and settings section heads. Five words or fewer.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Countdown numbers; set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so seconds don't jitter.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Setting names and list item titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Shoulders back, feet flat, screen at eye level.
styles.usage: Toast body and all running copy. Matches the Windows 14px base.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chips, meta lines (interval, time), setting descriptions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; gap between chip and meta line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a toast's body and its actions; switch-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Toast padding; settings row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Settings card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between settings cards; window gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Break screen and Settings page margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small surfaces: tooltips, tray menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Toasts and settings cards: big and soft, like Brady.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and switch tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every floating glass surface: toasts, the tray flyout.

blur.note: Backdrop blur radii; pair with saturate(140%). Map to Windows Acrylic in native code.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on toasts and glass panels.

tokens.name: blur-soft
tokens.usage: Small glass elements over busy content (glass buttons, chips on imagery).
